digest.component_or_area: CLI command interface and bridge maintenance commands
propositions: Three CLI verbs must be renamed to noun-based spellings: `rebar bridge-fsck` becomes `rebar bridge fsck`, `rebar bridge-probe` becomes `rebar bridge check-access`, and `rebar jira-onboard` becomes `rebar bridge setup`.
Old verb spellings must remain as functional compatibility entrypoints that route to identical implementations, preserving all behavior, output schema, exit status, and options.

The `rebar bridge check-access` verb must perform the exact same Jira round-trip (create/label/search/delete issue) as the legacy `bridge-probe` without being a flag of `fsck`, justified by the fact that it mutates remote state unlike read-only narrowing-flag precedents.

The `rebar bridge setup` command must retain the `jira-onboard` wizard's full behavior including `--no-validate`, `--reset`, `--yes`, `--url/--user/--project` options and must call `bridge check-access` as its final validation step with environment overlay injection.

All consumers of the three old verb names must be migrated in a single atomic change, including help text, schema descriptions, tests, scripts, workflows, documentation, and string-named references identifiable only by grep.
Schema registration for `bridge_fsck` must update both the `$id` and `description` fields to reference the new canonical verb name `rebar bridge fsck`.
